biomarkers.name: PAX8-PPARG fusion
biomarkers.clinical_use: Characteristic driver fusion in a subset of FTC

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Follicular architecture without papillary nuclear features; diagnosis requires capsular and/or vascular invasion
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Categorised by extent of invasion; widely invasive has worst prognosis

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Fibrous capsule; follicular architecture with colloid

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Thyroid follicular epithelial cells (same as PTC)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Follicular differentiation preserved with colloid production; RAS/PPARG-driven biology distinct from BRAF-driven PTC
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Progression to poorly differentiated then anaplastic thyroid carcinoma through TP53 and TERT acquisition — same dedifferentiation axis as PTC
